og_title: Memopezil Price: What Each Package Really Costs Per Day
desc: Memopezil price broken down per day, per capsule and per 12-week course, with shipping, the 60-day guarantee and which package fits a fair bacopa trial.
h1_b: What Each Package Really Costs Per Day
subhead: Per-bottle prices hide the number that matters. Here's the daily cost of each package, what a full bacopa course costs, and how to check the current price before you pay.
alt: Calculator on a sheet of paper, used to work out the Memopezil price per day
takeaways: Three packages, three daily costs. At the published rates, Memopezil works out to about $2.63, $2.30 or $1.63 a day, depending on how many bottles you buy.
One bottle is one month. Each bottle holds 60 capsules and the serving is two, so every bottle covers 30 days.
Shipping only applies to the 2-bottle pack. The 3 and 6-bottle packs ship free within the US.
No subscription or auto-ship. It's a one-time charge, and all three packs carry the same 60-day money-back guarantee.

pull: A bottle price tells you what you pay today. A daily price tells you what the habit costs. Only the second one is useful for deciding.
body: The Memopezil price at the time of writing is $79, $69 or $49 per bottle, depending on whether you buy 2, 3 or 6 bottles. Each bottle lasts 30 days at two capsules a day, so the daily cost runs from about $2.63 down to $1.63. Only the 2-bottle pack adds shipping, and none of them is a subscription.

Those numbers come from the manufacturer's published rates, which is also what our full Memopezil review lists. Prices in this category do move, though, so treat every dollar figure on this page as a snapshot. The math is the part that stays useful.
How much does Memopezil cost per bottle?

There's no single price. Memopezil is sold in three bundles, and the per-bottle rate drops as the bundle gets bigger. That's normal for products sold direct from the manufacturer's own checkout, and it means the sticker price you see first is usually the highest one.
Here are the published rates, with the totals and the daily cost worked out for you.

Two things jump out. The gap between the 2 and 3-bottle packs is small per day, about 33 cents. The jump to six bottles is much larger, roughly a dollar a day less than the starter pack. If you already know you'll take it for six months, that's where most of the saving sits.
What is the Memopezil price per day and per capsule?

Daily cost is the fairest way to compare any supplement, because bottle sizes and servings vary so much across brands. For Memopezil the arithmetic is simple. Divide the pack total by the number of days it covers. Every bottle is 60 capsules at two a day, so each one is 30 days.
2 bottles: $158 ÷ 60 days ≈ $2.63 a day, or about $1.32 per capsule. Shipping comes on top.
3 bottles: $207 ÷ 90 days = $2.30 a day, or $1.15 per capsule.
6 bottles: $294 ÷ 180 days ≈ $1.63 a day, or about 82 cents per capsule.

Put that in weekly terms and it's roughly $18, $16 or $11.50. For comparison, a daily coffee shop latte costs more than any of the three. That doesn't make the supplement worth it. It just helps you place the number.

Want to run the same check on a different brand? Find the total price, the number of capsules, and the labeled serving. Capsules divided by serving gives you days. Price divided by days gives you the daily cost. It takes thirty seconds and it cuts through most of the pricing tricks in this category.
Which Memopezil package should you buy?

This is where the timeline matters more than the discount. The ingredient in Memopezil with the strongest memory evidence is bacopa monnieri, and the trials that found an effect ran 8 to 12 weeks. Shorter studies mostly found nothing. Our page on what bacopa research actually shows goes into why it works slowly.
So ask a different question. Not "which pack is cheapest?" but "which pack lets me finish a fair trial?"

The 2-bottle pack is the one we'd think twice about. It has the highest daily cost, it charges shipping, and it runs out right around the point where bacopa trials start to show differences. You'd pay the most per day for a test that's too short to answer your question.

Three bottles is the realistic minimum for a proper trial. Six makes sense only once you have some reason to think you'll keep going. Buying six on day one is a bet, and the guarantee window doesn't stretch to cover all six months.
What a full 12-week trial actually costs
Bacopa's evidence window is about 84 days. Here's what covering it costs with each route, using the published rates.
Yes, with a week to spare

Reordering the starter pack is the worst deal on the table. You end up paying more than the 3-bottle price for an extra month you may not want, and you pay shipping twice. If you think you'll want a full test, buying three bottles up front is simply cheaper.

The 6-bottle pack costs $87 more than the 3-bottle one and gives you three more months. That's about 97 cents a day for those extra 90 days. Worth it only if the first three months go well, which you can't know on day one.
Only on the smallest order. The 2-bottle pack lists shipping as extra, and the exact charge is shown at checkout. The 3 and 6-bottle packs ship free within the United States.

That makes the real gap between the starter pack and the 3-bottle pack a little wider than the table suggests, since the shipping charge only lands on the cheaper total. If you're outside the US, check the checkout page for what applies to your address before entering card details. Our source pages don't cover international shipping, so we won't guess at it.
No. Each pack is a one-time charge with no auto-ship and no recurring billing. You pay once, the bottles arrive, and nothing else is charged unless you place another order yourself.

That's worth checking on any supplement you buy online, because a cheap trial that quietly turns into a monthly charge is one of the most common complaints in this market. The FTC has a short guide on buying health products online that covers what to look for. Read the order summary before you confirm, and keep the confirmation email.
How does the 60-day guarantee affect the real cost?

Every pack bought through the official checkout carries a 60-day money-back guarantee, and our review notes it applies whether bottles are full, partly used or empty. In plain terms, the money isn't final until day 60.

Here's the catch. Bacopa's evidence window is 8 to 12 weeks, and 60 days is about 8.5 weeks. If you want both a fair trial and a live refund option, you have to decide right at the boundary. Start the first bottle the day it arrives and set a reminder for week eight. The official terms page sets out how to claim, so read it the day you order.
Bought from a marketplace or a reseller? Then the guarantee doesn't apply at all. That alone can make a cheaper listing far more expensive if the product doesn't suit you.
Why is Memopezil not on Amazon, and are cheaper listings safe?

Memopezil is sold only through its official checkout. It isn't stocked by Amazon, Walmart, CVS or GNC. Any listing you find on a marketplace is either a reseller or a counterfeit, and neither is covered by the guarantee.

A lower price on an unofficial site should make you more careful, not less. You can't check where the bottles came from, how they were stored, or whether the capsules match the label. With supplements, that's a real risk. If a listing looks too cheap, it probably isn't the same product.
How do you check the current Memopezil price?
Go to the official order page and read the three packs directly. Then check these points before paying:
The per-bottle figure matches the pack size. If the numbers have changed since we wrote this, redo the daily math with the new total.
Shipping is shown before you confirm. On the 2-bottle pack it should be listed as a separate line.
There's no pre-ticked recurring box. The order should be one charge.
The guarantee is stated on the order page or the terms. Note the date you ordered; that's day one of the window.
You're on the official domain. Use the button on this page or the link in our review rather than a search ad from an unknown seller.
Prices go stale faster than articles do. If the checkout shows something different from this page, trust the checkout.
How does Memopezil's price compare with other memory supplements?

Comparing on bottle price is misleading, because servings differ so much. Some products are one capsule a day, some are two or three, and some bottles last 30 days while others last 45. Always convert to cost per day before you compare.

Price also isn't the only line that differs. Products like Prevagen and Neuriva are sold through stores, so their refund terms depend on which retailer you bought from. Memopezil's 60-day guarantee comes from the manufacturer and travels with every official order. Our pages on Prevagen alternatives and the rest of the category walk through those differences.

Then there's what you get for the money. A cheaper product with a hidden proprietary blend might be good value or might be mostly filler, and you can't tell. A more expensive one with every dose printed at least lets you check. Read the label before you read the price tag.

That depends on what you're paying for. Three of its five ingredients, bacopa, rhodiola and L-theanine, are at or near amounts used in research. Two, panax ginseng and the BCAAs, are well below studied doses. Our ingredient-by-ingredient guide covers each one. So part of every dollar goes to ingredients that are there more for the label than for the effect.

On the other side, every dose is printed. That's rarer than it should be, and it means you know what you're buying. Compared with the other formulas in our 2026 memory supplement rankings, $1.63 to $2.63 a day sits in the normal range for a multi-ingredient product with a real guarantee.

What the price doesn't buy is certainty. No clinical trial has tested the finished formula. Evidence for bacopa is not evidence for this bottle. And if your memory changes are sudden or getting worse, that's a doctor's appointment first, not a supplement order.

There's also a cost that never appears on the checkout page: your time. Twelve weeks of taking two capsules every morning is a real commitment. If the habits that matter most for memory, steady sleep, regular walking and treating things like high blood pressure, aren't in place yet, they'll do more for the same twelve weeks than any capsule. A supplement is an add-on to those, not a substitute. Spend the money once the basics are handled, and you'll also have a cleaner read on whether the product is doing anything.
Who should not spend the money
Anyone on blood thinners, diabetes or thyroid medication, antidepressants or sedatives who hasn't checked with their doctor. Ginseng and rhodiola both interact.
People who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Anyone wanting a same-day effect. This is a slow, cumulative formula.
Anyone who'd only ever buy one or two bottles. You'd stop before the evidence window opens.
faq: How much is one bottle of Memopezil?

Memopezil isn't sold as a single bottle through the official checkout. The smallest order is two bottles at $79 each, published at the time of writing, with shipping added. Larger packs bring the per-bottle price down to $69 or $49. Check the official order page for the current figures.
How long does one bottle of Memopezil last?
One bottle holds 60 capsules and the labeled serving is two capsules a day, so a bottle lasts 30 days. A 3-bottle pack covers about three months and a 6-bottle pack about six months.
Are there coupon codes for Memopezil?

The manufacturer's pricing is built on bundle size, and the review we base our figures on doesn't mention any coupon code. Pages promising secret codes often just link to the same three packs. Moving from two bottles to six changes the daily cost far more than a code would.
Can I get a cheaper price on eBay or Amazon?

You may see listings, but Memopezil is only sold through its official checkout. Marketplace listings are resellers or counterfeits, you can't verify what's in them, and they aren't covered by the 60-day money-back guarantee.
Does Memopezil ship outside the United States?

Free shipping on the 3 and 6-bottle packs applies to US addresses. For other countries, check the checkout page with your address entered before paying, since shipping options and charges are shown there.
Will I be charged again after my first order?
No. Memopezil is a one-time purchase with no subscription or auto-ship. You're only charged again if you place a new order yourself. Keep your order confirmation in case you need it.
Is it cheaper to buy the 6-bottle pack and return what I don't use?

Don't plan on that. The 60-day guarantee covers 60 days from purchase, not six months. Buy six only if you're fairly confident you'll keep taking it. Otherwise three bottles is the better-matched first order.
final_p: Prices can change. The official checkout shows the current rate for each pack, the shipping on the 2-bottle order, and the 60-day guarantee terms.
